release_notes:
SOC Chat App v1.0.18 - Unread Message Indicators & FCM Notifications:
- Added unread message count badge beside red dot on avatar
- Unread indicators disappear when chat is opened
- Integrated FCM push notifications for all platforms (iOS, Android, Web)
- FCM notifications sent to offline users automatically
- Fixed video loading issues on Android 10 with ngrok URLs
- Improved unread count reset and message read status
- Enhanced chat list refresh after opening chats
- Better platform-specific URL routing (Web: local network, Mobile: ngrok)
